cases.source_fault: The semantic validator permits numeric 0.0/1.0 to compare equal to boolean values without requiring the expected value type.
details: The recorder caches a newly seen code object as None and refuses it permanently once 128 functions are admitted. Early transport/runtime setup consumes that table.
Client.decide would at least expose the validator call, but it is also explicitly byte-pruned from context.
The query weights URL/base/client setup at url=10,base=6,client=7 versus confidence=3; value is excluded as a noise word.
The missing target cannot be repaired by better ranking alone. Runtime metadata must first retain late semantic functions or explicitly report incomplete coverage.

smallest_context_increment.change: Replace first-24 lexical selection plus tail dropping with failure-anchored, serialized-byte-aware packing of a bounded observed call-graph slice. Reserve the full failing test, then a small number of observed caller/callee neighbors for high-priority diagnostic functions before filling by marginal relevance per serialized byte.
smallest_context_increment.scope: Only previously observed function IDs and recorded edges; no target catalog, mutation labels, test edits or guessed execution.
small_additions: Give failed assertion/pytest.raises nodes higher query weight than client/transport setup.
Include bounded string field literals in comparisons/membership and raises(match=...), while excluding prose/docstrings and retaining existing secret guards.
Budget the actual JSON row cost, including source_numbered and reference metadata; avoid letting a large wrapper exclude multiple short connected helpers.
Keep the complete unnumbered source as canonical; render numbered source separately or omit duplicate numbered copies from the model projection if that projection can remain explicitly grounded.

separate_trace_increment.change: Expand the shared, strictly bounded function-admission/parser cap consistently (for example 128 to 256) or introduce a deterministic late-function reserve. Keep the 512k output cap and value-free tracing. Add admitted/dropped function and late-event coverage metadata.
separate_trace_increment.why_separate: e06 has no retained validator identity, so source ranking cannot select it without inventing execution. The context validator also hard-caps functions at128 and must agree with any recorder cap change.
separate_trace_increment.caveat: A larger first-seen cap only delays saturation; a fair prefix-plus-late reserve is the stronger generic design. No improvement has been measured in this read-only task.

not_recommended: Hardcoding any of the four target symbols or benchmark case IDs.
Selecting mutation locations or catalog repair labels.
Claiming source presence proves the model will generate a valid repair.
Treating a missing runtime function as proof it did not execute.
